expectedIssues: Pizza category is selected but the feed still shows all cuisines
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card row and the category filter chips are clipped at the right screen edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll indicator or fade/gradient hint that more content exists off-screen.
The bottom navigation bar sits flush against the device home indicator with no safe-area padding, which can cause the labels/icons to feel cramped or be obscured on notched/gesture devices.
The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot badge with no numeric count or text alternative, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.

expected.reasoning: No reported issue describes a filtering problem where the pizza category selection fails to update the feed; all reported issues concern layout, clipping, padding, and accessibility of UI elements rather than filter functionality.
